Thought: I need to build a row-standardized spatial weights matrix and compute Moran’s I for the 2021-2022 waste changes. I will also run a permutation test with at least 500 shuffles to get a p-value.
Action:
```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

DATASET_PATH = 'chunks_csv/changespillover/changespillover_2021_2022_waste.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
df = df.sort_values('borough').reset_index(drop=True)
df['change'] = df['Waste_2022'] - df['Waste_2021']
boroughs = df['borough'].tolist()
n = len(boroughs)
idx_map = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(boroughs)}

adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)
# Build adjacency list
neighbors = {b: set() for b in boroughs}
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    b = row['borough']
    nb = row['neighbor']
    if b in idx_map and nb in idx_map:
        neighbors[b].add(nb)
        neighbors[nb].add(b)  # ensure symmetry

# Build row-standardized weights matrix W
W = np.zeros((n, n))
for b in boroughs:
    i = idx_map[b]
    nbs = neighbors[b]
    deg = len(nbs)
    if deg > 0:
        for nb in nbs:
            j = idx_map[nb]
            W[i, j] = 1.0 / deg

# Compute Moran's I
x = df['change'].values
z = x - np.mean(x)
denom = np.sum(z * z)
lag = W.dot(z)
num = np.sum(z * lag)
S0 = np.sum(W)
moran_I = (n / S0) * (num / denom)
print('S0:', S0)
print('Morans I:', moran_I)
print('Mean change:', np.mean(x))
print('Std change:', np.std(x, ddof=1))
print('Change values:', x)

# Permutation test
np.random.seed(42)
n_perm = 1000
perm_stats = np.empty(n_perm)
for p in range(n_perm):
    z_perm = np.random.permutation(z)
    num_p = np.sum(z_perm * W.dot(z_perm))
    denom_p = np.sum(z_perm * z_perm)
    perm_stats[p] = (n / S0) * (num_p / denom_p)

p_value = np.mean(perm_stats >= moran_I)
print('P-value (one-sided, >= observed):', p_value)
print('Mean perm stat:', np.mean(perm_stats))
print('Std perm stat:', np.std(perm_stats))
```

import pandas as pd

    b = row['borough']
    nb = row['neighbor']
    if b in idx_map and nb in idx_map:
        neighbors[b].add(nb)
        neighbors[nb].add(b)

# Check for isolated boroughs
for b in boroughs:
    if len(neighbors[b]) == 0:
        print('Isolated:', b)

# Row-standardized W
W = np.zeros((n, n))
for b in boroughs:
    i = idx_map[b]
    nbs = neighbors[b]
    deg = len(nbs)
    if deg > 0:
        for nb in nbs:
            j = idx_map[nb]
            W[i, j] = 1.0 / deg

x = df['change'].values
z = x - np.mean(x)
lag = W.dot(z)
num = np.sum(z * lag)
denom = np.sum(z * z)
S0 = np.sum(W)
moran_I = (n / S0) * (num / denom)
print('S0:', S0)
print('Morans I:', moran_I)
print('Changes:', x)

# Permutation test with 1000 shuffles
np.random.seed(123)
n_perm = 1000
perm_stats = np.empty(n_perm)
for p in range(n_perm):
    z_perm = np.random.permutation(z)
    num_p = np.sum(z_perm * W.dot(z_perm))
    denom_p = np.sum(z_perm * z_perm)
    perm_stats[p] = (n / S0) * (num_p / denom_p)

p_value = np.mean(perm_stats >= moran_I)
print('P-value (one-sided, >= observed):', p_value)
print('Permutation mean:', np.mean(perm_stats))
print('Permutation std:', np.std(perm_stats))
